findings.title: Fallback chain reads SiteSetting on every lookup
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList#[]` calls `SiteSetting.default_locale` each time it is invoked. Once `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` is included, every translation miss or lookup goes through `I18n.fallbacks[locale]`, so this adds a SiteSetting read (and a `uniq`/array allocation) per translation call, on a hot path. The result could be memoized or derived from a cache that is invalidated when default_locale changes.

findings.title: LRU translation cache key ignores the fallback chain and default locale
findings.body: `translate` caches results keyed only by `key`, `config.locale` and the backend object id. With fallbacks now enabled, the resolved string depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale` (the second element of the fallback chain). If the site default locale changes, cached translations for locales that previously fell through to the default will keep returning the old text until the cache is evicted or `reload!` is called. The cache key should include the fallback chain or the cache should be cleared when default_locale changes.

findings.title: Fallback locales are loaded only for web requests
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is called only in `set_locale`, a controller before_filter. Background jobs, mailers, and rake tasks that call I18n will get the fallback chain from `FallbackLocaleList` (site default and :en) but those locales' YAML files are only loaded when `translate` is called for them, and the chain is not explicitly loaded there. Those contexts can silently return missing-translation text when the user locale is missing a key. Consider loading the fallback chain in the accelerator's `translate` path or in the job/mailer setup.

findings.title: Removing i18n fallback config in some environments but not others
findings.body: The `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` setting is removed from production, profile and cloud66 configs, while the fallback module is now enabled unconditionally by the new initializer. Other environments (development/test) may still set the Rails config, so behavior is now split across environments and the Rails setting is dead/misleading in the ones that still have it. Either remove it everywhere or document the intent.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! runs on every request
findings.body: `set_locale` calls `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` on every request, which builds the fallback array and calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!` for each locale. `ensure_loaded!` performs an Array `include?` check each time. This is cheap individually but is per-request work that could be skipped once the locales are loaded.

findings.title: PR description is missing
findings.body: The PR description is just 'Test 9' and gives no rationale for enabling fallbacks globally, moving the pluralization require into a new initializer, or the cache implications. A maintainer reviewing this cannot tell what behavior change is intended.
